query: db.events.aggregate([ { $facet: { high: [{ $match: { "attendance": { $lt: 70 } } }, { $group: { _id: "$city", count: { $sum: 1 } } }], low: [{ $match: { "attendance": { $lte: 70 } } }, { $group: { _id: "$city", count: { $sum: 1 } } }] } }, { $project: { _id: 0, high: 1, low: 1 } }])

db.events.aggregate([ { $facet: { high: [{ $match: { "attendance": { $gt: 70 } } }, { $group: { _id: "$city", count: { $sum: 1 } } }], low_disabled: [{ $match: { "attendance": { $lte: 70 } } }, { $group: { _id: "$city", count: { $sum: 1 } } }] } }, { $project: { _id: 0, high: 1, low: 1 } }])
